title: Watch Configurator with Strap Swap
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D watch configurator using Three.js. The scene features a watch built from primitives, with a Duck.glb mascot model, and allows users to swap straps and customize the watch face.

## Scene Setup
1. Use THREE.js via CDN (r158+) with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls.
2. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 5) looking at the origin.
3. Add a DirectionalLight at (5, 10, 7) intensity 1.5, an AmbientLight intensity 0.4, and a subtle PointLight at (-3, 2, -3) intensity 0.5.
4. Background color: #1a1a2e (dark navy).
5. Add a circular platform (CylinderGeometry radius 2, height 0.1) at y=-0.5 with metallic material color #333344.

## Watch Model (Built from Primitives)
1. Watch case: CylinderGeometry(0.8, 0.8, 0.2, 64) at origin, metallic silver (#c0c0c0) with roughness 0.2.
2. Watch face: CircleGeometry(0.75, 64) on top of case, dark (#111122).
3. Hour hand: BoxGeometry(0.04, 0.3, 0.02) pivoted at center of face, color white.
4. Minute hand: BoxGeometry(0.03, 0.45, 0.02) pivoted at center, color white.
5. Watch crown: CylinderGeometry(0.08, 0.08, 0.15, 16) on the right side of the case at x=0.85.
6. Top strap: BoxGeometry(0.5, 1.2, 0.08) positioned above the case at y=0.7, default color 'leather_brown' (#8B4513).
7. Bottom strap: BoxGeometry(0.5, 1.2, 0.08) positioned below the case at y=-0.7, same default color.
8. Group all watch parts into a single THREE.Group called watchGroup.

## Duck Mascot
1. Load 'Duck.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at position (2.5, -0.4, 0) with scale (0.015, 0.015, 0.015).
2. The duck slowly bobs up and down (sinusoidal, amplitude 0.1, period 2 seconds).
3. When a strap is swapped, make the duck do a quick spin (360 degrees over 0.5 seconds).

## Strap Options
Define 5 strap materials:
- 'leather_brown': color #8B4513, roughness 0.8
- 'leather_black': color #1a1a1a, roughness 0.7
- 'silicone_blue': color #2244aa, roughness 0.5
- 'silicone_red': color #aa2222, roughness 0.5
- 'metal_silver': color #c0c0c0, roughness 0.2, metalness 0.9

## Watch Face Color Options
Define 3 face colors:
- 'dark': #111122
- 'white': #f0f0f0
- 'blue': #1a3a6a

## UI (DOM Overlay)
1. Create a panel on the left side (position absolute, left 20px, top 50%, transform translateY(-50%)).
2. Title: 'Watch Configurator' in white, font-size 18px.
3. Section 'Strap Material' with 5 buttons, each labeled with strap name. Each button has id='strap_{name}' (e.g., 'strap_leather_brown'). Style with a small color swatch.
4. Section 'Face Color' with 3 buttons, each labeled. Each button has id='face_{name}' (e.g., 'face_dark').
5. A 'Rotate Watch' toggle button with id='btn_rotate'. When active, the watch auto-rotates on Y axis at 0.5 rad/s.
6. A 'Reset' button with id='btn_reset' that resets strap to leather_brown, face to dark, rotation off.
7. A price display div with id='price_display' showing a computed price: base $299, leather_brown +$0, leather_black +$20, silicone_blue +$15, silicone_red +$15, metal_silver +$80. Face dark +$0, white +$10, blue +$25.

## Watch Hands Animation
1. The minute hand rotates continuously (1 full rotation per 60 seconds).
2. The hour hand rotates continuously (1 full rotation per 720 seconds).
3. Hands rotate around Z axis on the watch face.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- currentStrap: string (e.g., 'leather_brown')
- currentFace: string (e.g., 'dark')
- autoRotate: boolean
- totalPrice: number
- duckLoaded: boolean (true once Duck.glb loads)
- duckSpinning: boolean (true during spin animation)
- watchRotationY: number (current Y rotation of watchGroup in radians)
- minuteHandAngle: number (current Z rotation in radians)
- hourHandAngle: number (current Z rotation in radians)
- strapSwapCount: number (total number of strap swaps performed)
- faceSwapCount: number (total number of face color changes)
- frameCount: number (incremented each animation frame)

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.

## OrbitControls
Enable OrbitControls with damping. Limit polar angle to [0.3, 1.5]. Enable zoom with min/max distance 2/10.

Ensure all interactions are smooth with proper material updates (no flickering). The configurator should feel polished and responsive.
physics_constraints: Watch hands must rotate at correct angular velocities (minute: 2*PI/60 rad/s, hour: 2*PI/720 rad/s). Duck bobbing follows sinusoidal motion. Auto-rotation is constant angular velocity. All rotations must be NaN-free and continuous.
